name: use-available-connectors
title: useAvailableConnectors
description: Filters unavailable injected wallets while preserving mobile and remote wagmi connectors.
docs:
```tsx
import { useAvailableConnectors } from "@/hooks/use-available-connectors"

const { connectors, isProbing } = useAvailableConnectors()
```

Injected connectors are probed for an announced browser provider. Remote connectors such as `metaMask()` and `walletConnect()` remain available so they can open a wallet app or display their connection UI.
